text: A WASP application shall be able to setup a phone call connection and a video chat connection using the 3G Platform via the WASP platform. Add video call and chat functionality.
The platform must be able to store POI and service profiles. Remove service profile functionality.
The WASP platform MUST be  able to  show the  location of users on  a map  by  marking them with a circle.
The WASP platform SHOULD  be possible  to determine  the location of touristic attractions. Deviate from the calculated route to visit an attraction.
Point of interest (POI) functionality is removed.

When changes are discovered in the status of a user's buddy, the WASP platform must sent out notifications according to the alerts set by the user (see also REQ_NOT_006). Remove functionality to track the location of users.
